title: TaskRaiseRailScope
description: The scope of task.raise_rail (M1 slice plan P17a, P17b; §6 L3): an operator raises one of a task's rails above the cap in force, for that task only, and every budget_rail hold of the task on that rail clears. A count rail takes to; per_task_usd takes to_usd (P17b); per_day_usd is the project's, raised only by a profile change.

RaisableRail.description: A rail of the project profile's budget.rails a task raises: a count rail, or per_task_usd.

RailCap.description: A raised count cap: above the one in force.
